modules.module_title: Performing functional tests on Xray device

pcs.pc_description: Receive X-ray device from box assembly operators
Complete the documentation as percompanys policy / SOP
Perform Tube Seasoning test, Over KV test and Calibration with different ranges of mA usingdigital multi-meter and Digital Storage Oscilloscope

Perform Dose-kVp Linearity test, Dose- mAs Linearity test, kVp Accuracy and repeatability test,HVL (Half Value Layer) test, Radiation output test,reproducibility test and reciprocity test using test software, Digital multimeter and Digital Storage Oscilloscope (DSO)
If test readings are within the specified limits mentioned in the SOP, send the device for electrical safety testing

modules.module_title: Performing functional tests on Ultrasound device

pcs.pc_description: Receive ultrasound device from box assembly operators
Complete the documentation as per companys policy / SOP

Put ultrasound machine on operation mode and conduct Monitor resolution test, Spatial distortion test, Grey scale uniformity test, Depth of visualization test, Low contrast visibility test, Display artefacts, Distance measurement test, Area estimation test and String object test as per the model specific SOP using Tissue Mimicking Phantoms
If test readings are within the specified limits mentioned in the SOP, send the device for electrical safety testing

modules.module_title: Perform functional tests on Patient Monitoring device

pcs.pc_description: Receive patient monitoring device from box assembly operators
Complete the documentation as per company policy / SOP
Plug in the power supply, turn it on and connect the Patient Monitoring Device to simulator(s) and Digital Storage Oscilloscope
Take Patient Monitoring Devices graph measurements, parameters and Digital Storage Oscilloscopes readings
Compare PMDs readings with simulator sreadings
If readings are within the specified limits mentioned in the SOP, send the device for electrical safety testing
